categories.ai_api_endpoint: A documented API ingress URL, domain or workspace template; its location is not an inference facility.
categories.ai_service_platform: A provider-declared model/agent/inference platform with product scope and availability caveats; not a deployment region or physical facility.
categories.ai_service_region: A named product region or model service pool, with access/storage and inference execution semantics kept distinct.
categories.cloud_product_region: A named cloud-product region with source labels and product availability; no manufactured provider region/AZ codes.
categories.gpu_product_catalog: Itemized GPU instance-family declarations; catalog membership does not establish installed GPU count or regional purchase availability.
categories.model_service_listing: A provider's explicit model or model-family service listing, potentially scoped to a named pool; not GPU capacity or developer ownership.
